sections.passage_title: The impacts of global warming and climate change
paragraphs: Protecting the environment plays an essential role in contemporary society. Engaging with this topic encourages high school students to reflect on their daily habits and global responsibilities.

Through systematic inquiry into Combating deforestation, pollution, global warming & biodiversity loss, learners cultivate critical thinking, broaden their vocabulary, and prepare for academic communication.
